documents.title: IS 1786:2008 High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
documents.content:
IS 1786:2008 - High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification.
Scope: Covers requirements of high strength deformed steel bars (TMT bars) and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 500S, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600.
Mandatory QCO: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020.
Scheme: Scheme I - Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)

documents.title: IS 14543:2004 Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
documents.content:
IS 14543:2004 - Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification.
Scope: Specifies physical, chemical, microbiological, toxic element, pesticide residue, and radio-isotope requirements for packaged drinking water sold in sealed bottles or containers.
Mandatory QCO: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations & FSSAI/BIS Joint Mandate.
Scheme: Scheme I - Mandatory ISI Certification Scheme

documents.title: IS 10500:2012 Drinking Water - Specification
documents.content:
IS 10500:2012 - Drinking Water - Specification.
Scope: Prescribes requirements, essential parameters, and desirable limits for drinking water supplied through municipal networks or decentralized sources across India.
Mandatory QCO: Voluntary.
Scheme: Voluntary Benchmark / Standard Guideline

documents.title: IS 15820:2009 General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres
documents.content:
IS 15820:2009 - General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres.
Scope: Specifies general requirements for competence, quality management systems, equipment, and XRF/Fire Assaying testing procedures for BIS Hallmarking Centres.
Mandatory QCO: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020 (Amended 2021 & 2023).
Scheme: Hallmarking Scheme (IS 1417 for Gold, IS 2112 for Silver)
documents.metadata: {"mandatory":true,"scheme":"Hallmarking Scheme (IS 1417 for Gold, IS 2112 for Silver)"}

documents.title: IS 13252 (Part 1):2010 Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
documents.is_number: IS 13252 (Part 1)
documents.content:
IS 13252 (Part 1):2010 - Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements.
Scope: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including microprocessors, laptops, servers, power adapters, and electronic data processing equipment.
Mandatory QCO: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) Order by MeitY.
Scheme: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS / R-Number)

documents.title: IS 694:2010 Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor, for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V
documents.is_number: IS 694
documents.content:
IS 694:2010 - Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor, for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V.
Scope: Covers single-core and multi-core PVC insulated electrical cables used for domestic wiring, industrial power supply, lighting, and electrical appliances up to 1100 Volts.
Mandatory QCO: Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices (Quality Control) Order, 2023.
Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme

documents.title: IS 302 (Part 1):2024 Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
documents.is_number: IS 302 (Part 1)
documents.content:
IS 302 (Part 1):2024 - Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements.
Scope: Applies to safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, such as electric irons, water heaters, room heaters, mixers, food processors, and microwave ovens.
Mandatory QCO: Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023.
Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme

documents.title: IS 16333 (Part 3):2017 Mobile Phone Handsets - Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets - Specific Requirements
documents.is_number: IS 16333 (Part 3)
documents.content:
IS 16333 (Part 3):2017 - Mobile Phone Handsets - Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets - Specific Requirements.
Scope: Specifies mandatory requirements for message typing, display of text, and keyboard entry for 22 official Indian languages on all mobile handsets sold in India.
Mandatory QCO: Mandatory Mobile Phone Language Support Order by MeitY.
Scheme: Scheme II - CRS Compulsory Registration Scheme

documents.title: IS 9873 (Part 1):2019 Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
documents.is_number: IS 9873 (Part 1)
documents.content:
IS 9873 (Part 1):2019 - Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties.
Scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Covers physical hazards like sharp edges, small parts choke hazards, heavy metal migration, and phthalates.
Mandatory QCO: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020.
Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark (Type Testing + Factory Inspection)

IS 2062:2011 - Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification.
Scope: Covers requirements for structural steel sections, plates, flats, beams, channels, and angles used in bridges, transmission towers, buildings, and general engineering.

documents.title: BIS Service: Product Certification (ISI Mark)
documents.is_number:
Product Certification (ISI Mark) (Conformity Assessment): The flagship ISI Mark scheme operated under Scheme-I of BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018. Ensures product safety, quality, and reliability through factory audits, sample testing, and continuous surveillance.
Target Audience: Domestic manufacturers, Foreign Manufacturers (FMCS), Importers
Portal: https://www.manakonline.in/

documents.title: BIS Service: Hallmarking Scheme (Gold & Silver)
documents.is_number:
Hallmarking Scheme (Gold & Silver) (Consumer Protection & Jewellery): Guarantees official purity and fineness of gold and silver jewellery. Features 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) laser etched at authorized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC).
Target Audience: Jewellers, Assaying & Hallmarking Centres, Consumers
Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-2/

documents.title: BIS Service: Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LIMS)
documents.is_number:
Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LIMS) (Testing & Calibration): BIS operates 8 Central/Regional laboratories and recognizes hundreds of independent NABL-accredited commercial and government laboratories under the Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS).
Target Audience: Testing Laboratories, R&D Institutions, Manufacturers
Portal: https://www.lims.bis.gov.in/

documents.title: BIS Service: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
documents.is_number:
Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) (Electronics & IT Goods): Simplified registration scheme (Scheme-II) for electronics and IT products based on self-declaration of conformity supported by test reports from BIS recognized labs.
Target Audience: Electronics Manufacturers, Brand Owners, Importers
Portal: https://www.crsbis.in/

documents.title: BIS Service: BIS Standards Clubs in Schools & Colleges
documents.is_number:
BIS Standards Clubs in Schools & Colleges (Youth & Academic Outreach): Educational initiative establishing Standards Clubs across high schools and engineering colleges to instill quality consciousness, standard drafting awareness, and consumer rights in students.
Target Audience: Schools, Colleges, Teachers, Students
Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/standards/standards-clubs/

documents.title: BIS Service: National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS)
documents.is_number:
National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS) (Capacity Building): NITS Noida provides training programs on standardization, quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000), laboratory management, and auditing techniques.
Target Audience: Quality Managers, Industry Executives, Lead Auditors
Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/nits/

documents.title: BIS Service: Consumer Affairs & BIS Care App
documents.is_number:
Consumer Affairs & BIS Care App (Consumer Redressal): Enables consumers to verify authenticity of ISI Mark, CRS Registration, and Gold HUID codes, as well as lodge complaints regarding substandard products or misuse of BIS marks.
Target Audience: General Citizens, Consumers, Traders
Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/consumer-overview/

document_chunks.content: Standard IS 1786:2008: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification. Category: Civil & Structural Steel. Scope: Covers requirements of high strength deformed steel bars (TMT bars) and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 500S, Fe 550, Fe 550D, Fe 600.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark). Testing Requirements: 0.2 percent proof stress / yield stress determination, Tensile strength test and TS/YS ratio calculation, Elongation at fracture percentage, Bend and Rebend test, Chemical composition test (Carbon, Sulphur, Phosphorus, Carbon Equivalent), Mass per metre run tolerance check.
Official Clause 4.1 (Chemical Composition) of IS 1786: Maximum limits: Carbon 0.30% max for Fe 415, Sulphur 0.060% max, Phosphorus 0.060% max, S+P 0.110% max.
Official Clause 8.1 (Mechanical Properties) of IS 1786: For Fe 500D: Minimum Yield Stress 500 N/mm², Minimum Tensile Strength 565 N/mm², Minimum Elongation 16.0%.
Official Clause 9.2 (Rebend Test) of IS 1786: Mandatory 135 degree bend around mandrel followed by aging in 100°C boiling water for 30 minutes and unbending to 157.5 degrees without fracture.

Standard IS 14543:2004: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification. Category: Food & Agriculture. Scope: Specifies physical, chemical, microbiological, toxic element, pesticide residue, and radio-isotope requirements for packaged drinking water sold in sealed bottles or containers.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Food Safety and Standards (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations & FSSAI/BIS Joint Mandate). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - Mandatory ISI Certification Scheme. Testing Requirements: Microbiological testing (Escherichia coli, Coliforms, Salmonella, Pseudomonas aeruginosa), Pesticide residue testing (Individual pesticides max 0.0001 mg/L, Total pesticides max 0.0005 mg/L), Toxic metals analysis (Lead, Arsenic, Cadmium, Mercury, Chromium), Organoleptic parameters (pH 6.5-8.5, TDS max 500 mg/L, Turbidity max 2 NTU), Shelf-life stability test.

Official Clause 5.1 (Hygiene and Processing) of IS 14543: Water shall be derived from suitable sources and subjected to treatment processes like decantation, filtration, aeration, ozonation, UV treatment, and reverse osmosis.
Official Clause 6.2 (Pesticide Residues) of IS 14543: Pesticide residues shall be tested as per IS 14543 Annex D and Annex E using Gas Chromatography (GC-MS) or LC-MS/MS.
Official Clause 7.1 (Packaging) of IS 14543: Shall be packed in food grade containers conforming to IS 15410 or IS 10146 with tamper-evident seals bearing the ISI Mark.

Standard IS 10500:2012: Drinking Water - Specification. Category: Water & Sanitation. Scope: Prescribes requirements, essential parameters, and desirable limits for drinking water supplied through municipal networks or decentralized sources across India.. Mandatory Status: Voluntary Benchmark. Certified Scheme: Voluntary Benchmark / Standard Guideline. Testing Requirements: pH value (6.5 to 8.5), Total Dissolved Solids (TDS: Acceptable limit 500 mg/l, Permissible limit 2000 mg/l), Total Hardness as CaCO3 (Acceptable limit 200 mg/l, Permissible 600 mg/l), Fluoride content (Acceptable limit 1.0 mg/l, Permissible limit 1.5 mg/l), Bacteriological testing (E. coli nil in 100 ml).
Official Clause 4.1 (Organoleptic and Physical Parameters) of IS 10500: Color max 5 Hazen units, Odor agreeable, Turbidity max 1 NTU (permissible 5 NTU).
document_chunks.keywords: IS 10500, clause 4.1, Organoleptic and Physical Parameters

document_chunks.content: Official Clause 4.2 (General Parameters Concerning Substances Undesirable in Excessive Amounts) of IS 10500: Nitrate max 45 mg/l, Sulphate max 200 mg/l (permissible 400 mg/l), Iron max 1.0 mg/l.
document_chunks.clause_title: General Parameters Concerning Substances Undesirable in Excessive Amounts
document_chunks.keywords: IS 10500, clause 4.2, General Parameters Concerning Substances Undesirable in Excessive Amounts

document_chunks.content: Standard IS 15820:2009: General Requirements for Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres. Category: Jewellery & Precious Metals. Scope: Specifies general requirements for competence, quality management systems, equipment, and XRF/Fire Assaying testing procedures for BIS Hallmarking Centres.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order, 2020 (Amended 2021 & 2023)). Certified Scheme: Hallmarking Scheme (IS 1417 for Gold, IS 2112 for Silver). Testing Requirements: X-ray Fluorescence (XRF) non-destructive screening, Fire Assay (Cupellation) destructive gold purity determination as per IS 1417, Laser marking of HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification) 6-digit alphanumeric code.

Official Clause 6.1 (Sampling and Reception) of IS 15820: Jewellery received from registered jewelers must undergo strict log entry, weight verification to 0.01g precision, and non-destructive preliminary XRF testing.

Official Clause 8.3 (Fire Assaying Procedure) of IS 15820: Assaying shall follow cupellation technique in muffle furnace at 1100°C to achieve purity measurement accuracy down to parts per thousand (ppt).

Standard IS 13252 (Part 1):2010: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements. Category: Electronics & IT. Scope: Applicable to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including microprocessors, laptops, servers, power adapters, and electronic data processing equipment.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) Order by MeitY). Certified Scheme: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS / R-Number). Testing Requirements: Electric strength and insulation test (Hipot test), Touch current and protective conductor current measurement, Temperature rise test under normal and fault conditions, Mechanical strength and drop test, Flammability test of plastic enclosures (V-0, V-1 grades).

Official Clause 1.5 (Components Safety) of IS 13252 (Part 1): Critical safety components such as power supplies, optocouplers, transformers, and fuses must independently comply with relevant Indian Standards or IEC standards.
Official Clause 2.1 (Protection from Electric Shock) of IS 13252 (Part 1): Equipment shall be so constructed that live parts are not accessible to test finger probes during operation.
document_chunks.keywords: IS 13252 (Part 1), clause 2.1, Protection from Electric Shock

document_chunks.content: Standard IS 694:2010: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor, for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V. Category: Electrical Engineering. Scope: Covers single-core and multi-core PVC insulated electrical cables used for domestic wiring, industrial power supply, lighting, and electrical appliances up to 1100 Volts.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices (Quality Control) Order, 2023). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme. Testing Requirements: Conductor resistance test (ohms/km at 20°C), High voltage insulation test (3 kV AC for 5 minutes), Insulation resistance test at 20°C and 70°C, Tensile strength and elongation test of PVC insulation, Flame retardancy / Flammability test (IEC 60332-1), Thermal stability test.
Official Clause 6.1 (Conductors) of IS 694: Conductors shall consist of annealed high conductivity copper (plain or tinned) or aluminum as specified in IS 8130.
Official Clause 9.1 (Marking Requirements) of IS 694: The cable shall be embossed or printed with Manufacturer's Name, IS 694, Voltage Grade, and ISI Mark every 1 metre along the sheath.

Standard IS 302 (Part 1):2024: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements. Category: Household Electrical Products. Scope: Applies to safety of electrical appliances for household and similar purposes, such as electric irons, water heaters, room heaters, mixers, food processors, and microwave ovens.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2023). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme. Testing Requirements: Protection against access to live parts, Power input and current verification, Heating test and thermal limit switch verification, Leakage current and electric strength at operating temperature, Abnormal operation and locked-rotor testing, Moisture resistance and IP protection rating.
Official Clause 8.1 (Protection Against Shock) of IS 302 (Part 1): Appliance shall be constructed so that its enclosure provides adequate protection against accidental contact with live parts.
Official Clause 19.1 (Abnormal Operation) of IS 302 (Part 1): Appliance must not emit flames, molten metal, or poisonous gas when operated under simulated failure conditions like blocked thermostat.

Standard IS 16333 (Part 3):2017: Mobile Phone Handsets - Indian Language Support for Mobile Phone Handsets - Specific Requirements. Category: Telecom & Mobile Technology. Scope: Specifies mandatory requirements for message typing, display of text, and keyboard entry for 22 official Indian languages on all mobile handsets sold in India.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Mandatory Mobile Phone Language Support Order by MeitY). Certified Scheme: Scheme II - CRS Compulsory Registration Scheme. Testing Requirements: Font rendering verification for Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Malayalam, etc., Input text keyboard layout and character entry test, Emergency SOS button triggering test (triple press 112 / long press 5).
Official Clause 4.2 (Language Display Capability) of IS 16333 (Part 3): Mobile handsets must display incoming and outgoing SMS and system menus in all 22 official scheduled Indian languages.
Official Clause 5.1 (Text Input Capability) of IS 16333 (Part 3): Handsets with physical or virtual keyboards must support input in Hindi, English, and at least one regional language based on region.

Standard IS 9873 (Part 1):2019: Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties. Category: Consumer & Child Safety. Scope: Applies to all toys intended for use by children under 14 years of age. Covers physical hazards like sharp edges, small parts choke hazards, heavy metal migration, and phthalates.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark (Type Testing + Factory Inspection). Testing Requirements: Drop test, impact test, and torque test for small part detachment, Sharp edge and sharp point inspection, Heavy element migration testing (Antimony, Arsenic, Barium, Cadmium, Chromium, Lead, Mercury, Selenium), Phthalate content testing (DBP, BBP, DEHP, DINP, DNOP, DIDP max 0.1%).
Official Clause 4.1 (Small Parts Hazard) of IS 9873 (Part 1): Toys intended for children under 36 months must not fit entirely into small parts test cylinder to prevent choking.
Official Clause 4.7.1 (Accessible Edges) of IS 9873 (Part 1): Accessible glass or metal edges on toys shall not present an unreasonable risk of cut injury during normal use.

Standard IS 2062:2011: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification. Category: Metallurgy & Construction. Scope: Covers requirements for structural steel sections, plates, flats, beams, channels, and angles used in bridges, transmission towers, buildings, and general engineering.. Mandatory Status: MANDATORY under QCO (Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020). Certified Scheme: Scheme I - ISI Mark Certification Scheme. Testing Requirements: Tensile strength and Yield strength, Charpy V-notch Impact test at 0°C / -20°C, Chemical analysis (Carbon, Manganese, Silicon, Sulphur, Phosphorus, CE value), Dimensional tolerance and flatness check.
Official Clause 6.1 (Chemical Composition) of IS 2062: Carbon equivalent (CE) based on ladle analysis shall not exceed 0.42% for grade E250.
Official Clause 8.2 (Charpy Impact Test) of IS 2062: Impact energy for sub-zero quality grades shall meet minimum 27 Joules at specified temperature.

Quality Control Order: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020 (S.O. 2404(E), 2020-07-22) issued by Ministry of Steel. Summary: Prohibits manufacture, import, distribution, sale, or storage for sale of specified steel products without displaying the Standard Mark under a license from BIS. Mandatory Coverage: TMT Rebar (IS 1786); Structural Steel (IS 2062); Mild Steel Wire; Steel Sheets.

document_chunks.content: BIS Service Product Certification (ISI Mark): The flagship ISI Mark scheme operated under Scheme-I of BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018. Ensures product safety, quality, and reliability through factory audits, sample testing, and continuous surveillance. Key Steps: Submit application on Manakonline portal -> Factory audit by BIS inspecting officer -> Drawing samples & testing in BIS/NABL recognized laboratory -> Grant of License (GoL) upon satisfactory test report -> Periodic surveillance and market sample testing. Target: Domestic manufacturers, Foreign Manufacturers (FMCS), Importers. Portal: https://www.manakonline.in/
document_chunks.keywords: Product Certification (ISI Mark), Conformity Assessment, BIS scheme, https://www.manakonline.in/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service Hallmarking Scheme (Gold & Silver): Guarantees official purity and fineness of gold and silver jewellery. Features 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) laser etched at authorized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC). Key Steps: Jeweller registration on BIS portal -> Submission of jewellery batch to accredited AHC -> Fire assay testing and XRF non-destructive screening -> Laser engraving of BIS logo, purity grade, and 6-digit HUID code -> Consumer verification via BIS CARE Mobile App. Target: Jewellers, Assaying & Hallmarking Centres, Consumers. Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/hallmarking-2/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LIMS): BIS operates 8 Central/Regional laboratories and recognizes hundreds of independent NABL-accredited commercial and government laboratories under the Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS). Key Steps: Application via LIMS portal -> Assessment of technical competence & ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation -> On-site audit by BIS technical assessors -> Inter-laboratory proficiency testing (PT) -> Grant of BIS recognition status for specified Indian Standards. Target: Testing Laboratories, R&D Institutions, Manufacturers. Portal: https://www.lims.bis.gov.in/
document_chunks.keywords: Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LIMS), Testing & Calibration, BIS scheme, https://www.lims.bis.gov.in/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS): Simplified registration scheme (Scheme-II) for electronics and IT products based on self-declaration of conformity supported by test reports from BIS recognized labs. Key Steps: Test product in BIS recognized lab in India -> Obtain valid test report -> Submit online application on CRS portal with affidavit of conformity -> Grant of Registration (R-number assigned) -> Affix CRS logo with R-Number on product packaging. Target: Electronics Manufacturers, Brand Owners, Importers. Portal: https://www.crsbis.in/
document_chunks.keywords: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS), Electronics & IT Goods, BIS scheme, https://www.crsbis.in/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service BIS Standards Clubs in Schools & Colleges: Educational initiative establishing Standards Clubs across high schools and engineering colleges to instill quality consciousness, standard drafting awareness, and consumer rights in students. Key Steps: Institution registration with BIS Regional Office -> Formation of Student Club with Mentor Teacher -> Organizing industrial exposure visits, quizzes, and competitions -> Financial grant support from BIS for club activities. Target: Schools, Colleges, Teachers, Students. Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/standards/standards-clubs/
document_chunks.keywords: BIS Standards Clubs in Schools & Colleges, Youth & Academic Outreach, BIS scheme, https://www.bis.gov.in/standards/standards-clubs/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS): NITS Noida provides training programs on standardization, quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000), laboratory management, and auditing techniques. Key Steps: Browse course directory on NITS portal -> Select online or classroom training module -> Complete registration & payment -> Attend training and pass evaluation assessment -> Receive BIS NITS Certificate. Target: Quality Managers, Industry Executives, Lead Auditors. Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/nits/
document_chunks.keywords: National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS), Capacity Building, BIS scheme, https://www.bis.gov.in/nits/

document_chunks.content: BIS Service Consumer Affairs & BIS Care App: Enables consumers to verify authenticity of ISI Mark, CRS Registration, and Gold HUID codes, as well as lodge complaints regarding substandard products or misuse of BIS marks. Key Steps: Download BIS CARE App from Play Store / App Store -> Enter HUID or ISI License / R-Number -> View instant verification status and manufacturer details -> Lodge complaint with photos/location if non-compliant. Target: General Citizens, Consumers, Traders. Portal: https://www.bis.gov.in/consumer-overview/

messages.content: Is IS 14543 mandatory for packaged drinking water?

### Official BIS Evidence Summary

Based on official Bureau of Indian Standards documentation retrieved for your inquiry:

#### 1. **IS 14543** (Clause 5.1)
Official Clause 5.1 (Hygiene and Processing) of IS 14543: Water shall be derived from suitable sources and subjected to treatment processes like decantation, filtration, aeration, ozonation, UV treatment, and reverse osmosis.

#### 2. **IS 14543** (Clause 7.1)
Official Clause 7.1 (Packaging) of IS 14543: Shall be packed in food grade containers conforming to IS 15410 or IS 10146 with tamper-evident seals bearing the ISI Mark.

#### 3. **IS 14543** (Clause 6.2)
Official Clause 6.2 (Pesticide Residues) of IS 14543: Pesticide residues shall be tested as per IS 14543 Annex D and Annex E using Gas Chromatography (GC-MS) or LC-MS/MS.

---
*Official Source References:* Verified from [Bureau of Indian Standards Repository](https://www.bis.gov.in/).

messages.content: Is IS 1786 mandatory for TMT steel bars?

### Official BIS Evidence Summary

Based on official Bureau of Indian Standards documentation retrieved for your inquiry:

#### 1. **IS 1786** (Clause 9.2)
Official Clause 9.2 (Rebend Test) of IS 1786: Mandatory 135 degree bend around mandrel followed by aging in 100°C boiling water for 30 minutes and unbending to 157.5 degrees without fracture.

#### 2. **IS 1786** (Clause 4.1)
Official Clause 4.1 (Chemical Composition) of IS 1786: Maximum limits: Carbon 0.30% max for Fe 415, Sulphur 0.060% max, Phosphorus 0.060% max, S+P 0.110% max.

#### 3. **IS 1786** (Clause 8.1)
Official Clause 8.1 (Mechanical Properties) of IS 1786: For Fe 500D: Minimum Yield Stress 500 N/mm², Minimum Tensile Strength 565 N/mm², Minimum Elongation 16.0%.

---
*Official Source References:* Verified from [Bureau of Indian Standards Repository](https://www.bis.gov.in/).
